title: BCI Competition 2020 Track 4 — Upper-limb grasping motor imagery
description: A preprocessed derivative EEG dataset from BCI Competition 2020 Track 4, containing motor imagery recordings of three right-arm grasping tasks (cylindrical, spherical, lumbrical) from 15 healthy subjects across three sessions. It provides 60-channel EEG at 250 Hz with 450 trials per subject, and is intended for evaluating session-to-session transfer learning in brain-computer interfaces. Data were notch filtered and epoched to the 4 s motor imagery window, and re-hosted in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was acquired with a BrainAmp system (BrainProducts) using 60 channels at 250 Hz, referenced to FCz with Fpz as ground. Subjects performed cue-based motor imagery of three grasping tasks in three sessions separated by 7 days. Each 10 s trial comprised 3 s rest, 3 s visual cue and 4 s motor imagery. Data were preprocessed with a 60 Hz notch filter and cue-aligned epoching, and the 4 s motor imagery window was extracted.
